checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Face structure, expression and features match closely.
Curly dark hair, knit sweater and head-and-shoulders crop are intact; the sweater is now tan/orange instead of grey.
Trees, path, grass and bench are still visible.

must.item: Warm faded grade and visible grain
must.why: Strong amber tone, vignette and grain; heavy but clearly vintage.

faults.what: Grade is very heavy orange, closer to a Polaroid or sepia cast than a subtle faded 1970s look; the grey sweater turns tan and skin looks overly orange.
Dark vignette edges, blown highlights at top, and hair shadow detail is lost.

summary: A convincing warm vintage-film version that keeps her face, hair, pose and park setting, though the orange cast is overdone and turns the grey sweater tan.
